claims.claim: Interactive mean supported hazard exposure index
claims.definition: Arithmetic mean of supported Nation values within the selected geography, on the source 0–1 index scale. The five displayed hazards are selected by frequency in the supported top-five rankings.
claims.qualification: Coverage and unavailable counts are shown separately. Hazard-specific indices are screening measures, not comparable monetary losses, probabilities or sovereign priorities. The frequency view and frozen reports retain their original definitions.
